description: Prepare a buy for the person to sign on marketmayhem.co: a token launched on Market Mayhem, or any token in a PancakeSwap V2 or V3 pool (curve, Infinity and Uniswap tokens: quote works; send them to marketmayhem.co/x/<token>). Returns a link and a summary; nothing is bought until they confirm in their own wallet.

amount.description: how much to spend: BNB for a token not launched on Market Mayhem (whatever its pair); the pair currency (e.g. BNB) for a Market Mayhem launch

referrer.description: a registered referrer (e.g. the app or agent that brought them) earns the referral share
